# Newsworthy.ai

> AI-powered press release distribution and news marketing platform enabling businesses to amplify their announcements across multiple channels with SEO optimization and flat-rate pricing.

Newsworthy.ai combines artificial intelligence with press release distribution to help companies gain news visibility and media outreach. The platform serves as both a distribution service and curated news aggregator featuring business announcements, product launches, and market updates from various industries.

## Key Topics

- Press Release Distribution
- AI-Powered News Platform

- Trending News
